definition: Techniques applied during data collection, training, or post-processing aimed at reducing unfair or discriminatory patterns in a model's outputs.
details: Bias mitigation approaches range from curating more representative training data to algorithmic interventions during training or inference, though eliminating bias entirely remains a significant and unresolved challenge.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. Boil it down and it is this: Techniques applied during data collection, training, or post-processing aimed at reducing unfair or discriminatory patterns in a model's outputs. Here is why it matters: Bias mitigation approaches range from curating more representative training data to algorithmic interventions during training or inference, though eliminating bias entirely remains a significant and unresolved challenge. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. That deliberate caution is Bias Mitigation.
